negative_results.result: 0/120000 checker mismatches and 0/60000 injection accepts are not a formal safety proof.
Append-only/versioned semantics can create storage-exhaustion DoS; absence of deletion does not solve resource risk.
Non-destructive local semantics do not make irreversible external effects such as payments/messages/API actions safe.
Opaque capability boundary can fail if host grants overbroad handles or trusted adapters drop labels.
Android R1 constructed harness is not full ClayCode compiler/runtime conformance or target performance evidence.
